name: OpenNeuro
notes: approx: 468 of 1,935 readable public datasets list eeg among snapshot modalities, subjects summed per dataset (the API's modality filter alone missed HBN Release 7); no hours field, but NEMAR's mirror of 434 of them sums about 77,700 h. BIDS-only, so cognitive and clinical research labs dominate: only 3 of MOABB's 206 BCI datasets live here.

name: NEMAR
programmatic_access: REST API (api.nemar.org/datasets); HTTPS file tree (data.nemar.org); Zarr; EEGDash
notes: approx: hours sum total_recording_duration for the 619 of 652 EEG datasets that report it. Mirrors 434 OpenNeuro EEG datasets ('on' IDs) and now hosts 218 of its own ('nm' IDs, 206 from one uploader), mostly BIDS conversions of BCI, PhysioNet and sleep datasets from other repositories.

name: EEGDash
programmatic_access: Python package eegdash (braindecode-compatible); REST API data.eegdash.org; Hugging Face Hub
notes: approx: chart-data API totals (691 of 697 with duration), including 11 HBN 'mini' subsets and 11 BDF re-releases of HBN; without them 675 datasets and 37,708 subjects. Indexes NEMAR (653) and OpenNeuro (22) so it inherits their lab mix; the site headline (955 datasets, 137,716 h, all modalities) is slightly ahead of the API (952).

name: Hugging Face Hub
programmatic_access: huggingface_hub; datasets library; braindecode Hub mixin
notes: approx: datasets whose name matches 'eeg', of which 738 are EEGDash mirrors of NEMAR/OpenNeuro data; a further 13 datasets sit under the braindecode org. The remaining ~260 are user uploads of mixed provenance and licence.

name: PhysioNet
notes: approx: 28 databases plus the 2018 Challenge whose metadata mention EEG or polysomnography, after removing 7 false positives; 24 are open, the rest restricted or credentialed. Sleep (Sleep-EDF, CAP, HMC), epilepsy (CHB-MIT, Siena), cardiac arrest (I-CARE) and US BCI data (EEGMMIDB, bigP3BCI); all 21 MOABB datasets sourced here are from US labs.

name: BNCI Horizon 2020 database
programmatic_access: direct HTTP download; MOABB BNCI loaders
notes: 29 of 32 entries carry EEG (others fNIRS or ECoG); the live site timed out today, so counts come from the 2026-10-12 Wayback snapshot. Graz University of Technology contributed 11 of the EEG sets and TU Berlin 8, almost all BCI paradigms.

name: BBCI BCI Competitions II-IV
programmatic_access: direct download after click-through terms; MOABB and braindecode loaders for some
notes: 16 EEG data sets across Competitions II (6), III (7 of 8, one ECoG) and IV (3 of 5, one MEG, one ECoG), from Berlin, Graz, Wadsworth and Tuebingen groups. Still the default BCI benchmarks (IV-2a is BNCI 001-2014); Competition I is hosted at Columbia.

name: Brain Data Science Platform (BDSP)
programmatic_access: web download after credentialing; per-project tools on GitHub (bdsp-core)
notes: approx: 50 of 72 listed projects carry the 'eeg' topic, many of them paper data-and-code packages; 43 databases are credentialed or restricted, 5 open. Run by Stanford's Clinical Data Animation Center with Harvard/MGH/BIDMC: Harvard EEG Database, Human Sleep Project v3.0 (119,234 PSG recordings, 90,166 patients), I-CARE, SPaRCNet.

name: Harvard Electroencephalography Database
programmatic_access: BDSP download after credentialing; Harvard-EEG-Database-Tools on GitHub
notes: v4.1 (published 2025-02-10): 284,343 clinical EEG studies from 109,178 patients at four sites, with linked EHR. Requires BDSP credentialed status and a signed project DUA; no hours figure given.

name: TUH EEG Corpus (Temple University Hospital)
programmatic_access: rsync over SSH after approval; braindecode TUH/TUHAbnormal/TUHEvents
notes: Official page lists TUEG v2.0.2 (26,846 recordings, 2002-2017) plus 6 labelled subsets (TUAB, TUAR, TUEP, TUEV, TUSZ, TUSL); the patient count is for TUEG v2.0.0 (14,987 patients, 26,846 sessions, 69,652 recordings) from arXiv 2401.10283. Single-hospital clinical archive; access needs a signed form emailed to NEDC, then SSH-key rsync.

name: National Sleep Research Resource (NSRR)
programmatic_access: NSRR Ruby gem; nsrr R package; Luna
notes: approx: 42 of 55 listed datasets are tagged Polysomnography, subjects summed from their cards; some are animal studies and some (e.g., HCHS, recorded on an ARES Unicorder) are home sleep tests, so not all have full EEG. Mostly US sleep cohorts and trials (SHHS, MESA, MrOS, CHAT, NCHSDB); the site carries a banner saying it is 'under review for potential modification'.

name: Healthy Brain Network (Child Mind Institute)
formats: EGI recordings; BIDS copies on OpenNeuro (BDF on NEMAR)
programmatic_access: NITRC/AWS for raw files; OpenNeuro ds005505-ds005516; EEGDash
notes: approx: subjects sum the non-BIDS EEG column of the HBN download table for releases 1.1-11 (the 11 BIDS releases on OpenNeuro hold 3,155). Child Mind Institute's transdiagnostic paediatric cohort; raw downloads need a NITRC login while the BIDS copies are open.

name: European Epilepsy Database (EPILEPSIAE)
notes: approx: hours are a lower bound ('> 45,000 hours'); 275 annotated patient datasets from over 250 patients (200+ scalp, 60 intracranial) with over 2,500 seizures. Paid licences only (e.g., 2,500 EUR for 25 surface datasets), now sold via Campus Technologies Freiburg.

name: NIMH Data Archive (NDA)
formats: NDA data structures plus raw EEG files
notes: approx: collections matching 'EEG' in NDA's search API (80 match 'electroencephalography'). EEG from NIH-funded mental-health studies (autism, psychosis, depression, adolescent sleep); access needs an institutionally signed Data Use Certification.

name: Zenodo
formats: any (MAT, EDF, BDF, FIF, zipped BIDS)
notes: approx: hits for q=EEG with type=dataset; the query also catches Germany's renewable-energy law (EEG), and 'electroencephalography OR electroencephalogram' gives 421. Largest home of MOABB BCI data (54 of 206), led by French labs such as GIPSA-lab Grenoble (Brain Invaders) and Inria.

name: Figshare
notes: approx: items of type dataset returned by the API search (search_for=EEG, item_type=3), which includes journal supplementary files. Hosts 17 MOABB datasets, largely Chinese groups (e.g., Tsinghua eldBETA) plus Greek MAMEM and Mexican BCI data.

name: OSF (Open Science Framework)
programmatic_access: OSF API v2; osfclient; SHARE search API
notes: approx: public OSF projects matching 'EEG' in the SHARE index (cardSearchText=EEG, resourceType=Project; 3,349 with components), many holding code or preregistrations rather than data. Favoured by psychology/ERP labs (ERP CORE) and Korea University's mobile and 2020-competition BCI sets in MOABB.

name: Harvard Dataverse
notes: approx: datasets returned by the Search API for q=EEG, type=dataset. 10 MOABB BCI datasets live here, 7 from Chinese groups (Tianjin University, CAS, World Robot Contest) and 2 from Japan.

name: Mendeley Data
notes: approx: results attributed to Mendeley Data for query=EEG on its search page (419 across all indexed sources). Elsevier's repository; its 5 MOABB datasets come from Mexico, Ecuador, Indonesia and Turkey.

name: IEEE DataPort
notes: approx: results for site search 'EEG': 181 standard datasets (subscription), 24 open access, 8 competitions. Mostly single-lab engineering datasets, often from consumer headsets (e.g., the Emotiv-based STEW workload set).

name: Dryad
notes: approx: hits for q=EEG in the Dryad search API (60 for 'electroencephalography'). Journal-linked CC0 deposits, human and animal; few large curated EEG collections.

name: Synapse (Sage Bionetworks)
notes: approx: public projects matching 'EEG' in the Synapse search API, several unrelated (e.g., mPower). Hosts TD-BRAIN (Brainclinics), BrainLat, HarMNqEEG multinational cross-spectra and FACED; access terms vary by project.

name: GigaDB
notes: approx: 8 EEG datasets among the 11 hits for 'EEG' in the GigaDB search API. Data notes for GigaScience; all 4 MOABB datasets here are Korean (Korea University OpenBMI Lee2019, GIST Cho2017).

name: EBRAINS Knowledge Graph
programmatic_access: KG search API; EBRAINS account for data
notes: approx: datasets matching 'EEG' (21 tagged electroencephalography; 13 controlled access, 12 free, 9 embargoed, 8 restricted). European Human Brain Project labs, e.g., TMS-EEG perturbational complexity and sEEG/hd-EEG stimulation studies.

name: G-Node GIN
notes: approx: public repositories matching 'EEG' from the GIN API, including forks and DOI copies. Small German/Swiss footprint (MPIB Berlin, USZ Zurich scalp EEG + iEEG, mouse hdEEG).

name: DANDI Archive
notes: approx: dandisets matching 'EEG'; mostly animal and intracranial (iEEG/sEEG, single-unit) recordings. DANDI is the BRAIN Initiative's NWB archive, with little human scalp EEG.

name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
notes: 4 datasets match 'EEG' in its API (EEG Database, EEG Eye State, EEG SSVEP signals, BEED epilepsy). Small, old ML-benchmark staples.

name: Kaggle competitions
notes: 37 competitions match 'EEG'; the research-tier EEG ones are seizure-detection and seizure-prediction (2014), grasp-and-lift-eeg-detection and inria-bci-challenge (2015), melbourne-university-seizure-prediction (2016) and hms-harmful-brain-activity-classification (2024). Data needs a Kaggle account and accepting each competition's rules.

name: Kaggle datasets
notes: approx: unique results of 'kaggle datasets list -s EEG' until pages stopped returning items. Mostly user re-uploads of public datasets (e.g., an OpenNeuro ds002778 copy, SAM40), so check provenance and licence.

name: Tsinghua University BCI Lab downloads
notes: 12 datasets, mostly SSVEP (Benchmark, BETA, eldBETA, wearable, 160-target) plus RSVP and collaborative BCI. Copies reappear via Zenodo/Figshare in MOABB (Wang2016, Liu2022EldBETA) and TorchEEG (TSUBenchmark).

name: SJTU BCMI SEED datasets
programmatic_access: none (application form); TorchEEG loaders after download
notes: 11 SEED-family datasets (emotion, vigilance, cross-cultural, sleep deprivation, video) from Shanghai Jiao Tong University's BCMI lab. Access via an application form; TorchEEG ships loaders for SEED, SEED-IV and SEED-V.

name: PREDiCT (Patient Repository for EEG Data + Computational Tools)
notes: approx: the 'Number of Patients' column sums to 570 across 14 task and rest datasets (Parkinson's, mTBI, depression, OCD, schizophrenia) from the University of New Mexico. PDDL public-domain licence; 64-channel BrainVision or Neuroscan recordings.

name: meagmohit/EEG-Datasets (curated list)
notes: Curated GitHub list (3,143 stars, last commit 2025-10-17) with 67 numbered entries in 11 paradigm sections plus an unfiltered link dump. A common discovery entry point that mostly points back to the repositories above.

name: MOABB
formats: per source (MAT, GDF, EDF, BDF, BrainVision, BIDS)
notes: approx: subjects summed across the 206 dataset classes in the docs table (develop; last release v1.7.2), and some classes share subjects. Its Repository column: Zenodo 54, PhysioNet 21, BNCI 19, Figshare 17, OSF 13, Harvard Dataverse 10, GitHub 7, Mendeley 5, GigaDB 4, OpenNeuro 3, blank 31.

name: braindecode
notes: v2.0.0 (released 2026-11-02) ships 11 named dataset classes (TUH, TUHAbnormal, TUHEvents, SleepPhysionet, SleepPhysionetChallenge2018, CHBMIT, SIENA, NMT, HGD, BNCI2014_001, BCICompetitionIVDataset4) plus MOABBDataset, BIDSDataset and Hugging Face Hub wrappers. Its clinical and sleep coverage complements MOABB's BCI focus; TUH classes need TUH access.

name: mne.datasets
notes: MNE 1.13.2's overview lists 9 datasets with scalp EEG (sample, SPM faces, EEGBCI, mTRF, Kiloword, Sleep PSG, ERP CORE, SSVEP, EyeLink EEG-eyetracking); LIMO is also EEG but not labelled so. Most other fetchers are MEG, OPM, sEEG/ECoG or phantoms; teaching-sized, not benchmarks.

name: TorchEEG
notes: 21 dataset loaders in v1.1.3 (latest, released 2024-12-23), weighted to affective EEG (SEED family, DEAP, DREAMER, AMIGOS, MAHNOB, FACED, MPED) plus sleep (HMC, ISRUC, Sleep-EDFx), BCI and auditory attention (KUL, DTU). Most loaders expect the raw files to be obtained first, several under request-only licences.
